name: Food at a Wake
source:
Virgil is taking a break from school right now to take care of his mom.

Virgil ran into his ex the other night.

Virgil is worried about prom.

Virgil's 14th birthday was a few days ago, and he's going to the beach.

This game tells the story of a boy named Virgil, told over the course of many years in non chronological order. It details Virgil coming to terms with his sexuality, dealing with the loss of his mother, and navigating important relationships in his life.

[From [url=https://aderie.itch.io/food-at-a-wake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维吉尔现在正在休学以照顾他的妈妈。

维吉尔那天晚上遇到了他的前任。

维吉尔担心舞会。

前几天是Virgil的14岁生日，他要去海滩。

该游戏讲述了一个名叫维吉尔的男孩的故事，故事以非时间顺序讲述了很多年。它详细介绍了维吉尔接受自己的性取向、处理失去母亲的情况以及处理生活中重要关系的故事。

[来自[url=https://aderie.itch.io/food-at-a-wake]Itch.io[/url]]
